tours.title: Start with a key
tours.description: Make a script run when you press a key.

steps.title: Start with a key
steps.text: This hat block starts the blocks under it whenever you press a key. Click its menu to choose which key.

steps.title: Try it yourself!
steps.text: I've added a “move 10 steps” block to your code area. Drag “when space key pressed” on top of it, then press the space bar. Your sprite moves each time!

waitFor.label: Drag the “when key pressed” block on top of the “move” block

tours.title: Start with a click
tours.description: Make a script run when you click a sprite.

steps.title: Start with a click
steps.text: This hat block starts the blocks under it when someone clicks the sprite. Great for buttons and characters that react.

steps.title: Try it yourself!
steps.text: I've added a “say Hello!” block to your code area. Drag “when this sprite clicked” on top of it, then click your sprite.

waitFor.label: Drag the “when this sprite clicked” block on top of the “say” block

steps.title: Send a message
steps.text: This block sends a message to every sprite. Any script waiting for that message starts.

steps.title: Receive a message
steps.text: This hat block starts its script when its message arrives, even from another sprite.

steps.title: Try it yourself!
steps.text: I've added a “when green flag clicked” block to your code area. Drag “broadcast message 1” under it. Then drag “when I receive message 1” into the code area, and put a “say” block under it. Click the green flag!

waitFor.label: Drag the “broadcast” block under the hat block
Drag “when I receive” into the code area
